description.zh: 一次完成 Excel 修改并保留格式（openpyxl）：按段重排、查找替换、统一字体、重新编号。默认另存为原文件旁边的「<原名>_修改.xlsx」，原表不动；overwrite=true 时先备份为「<原名>_备份.xlsx」再覆盖。保存后自动核对行数（只移动时还核对内容未变），返回每步改了什么。用户要求的改动都写进同一次调用；文件被 Excel 打开时会提示先关闭。
description.en: Make Excel changes in one call with formatting kept (openpyxl): reorder blocks, replace, one font, renumber. Saves '<name>_修改.xlsx' beside the source by default and leaves the source alone; overwrite=true first copies the source to '<name>_备份.xlsx'. Checks the saved file (row count; for pure moves, that content is unchanged) and reports each step. Put all requested changes in one call; a file open in Excel is reported so the user can close it.

path.description: 工作簿路径：附件的绝对路径，或工作目录内的相对路径

operations.description:
按顺序执行的操作列表，每项一个 op：
- reorder_blocks：{op, column, order:[值…], within?, match?:"contains"|"exact"} 把 column 中相同值组成的连续段按 order 排列，整行连格式移动；order 可写简称（「瑶海」匹配「瑶海支公司」）；未列出的段保持在后面原顺序
- replace：{op, find, replace, columns?:[列…], whole_cell?:bool} 查找替换文字
- set_font：{op, name?, size?, include_header?:bool} 统一字体/字号，粗体颜色等保留
- renumber：{op, column:"序号", start?:1, skip_if_blank?:列} 从数据第一行起重新连续编号

output.description: 输出文件名或路径（相对名放在原文件旁边），默认 <原名>_修改.xlsx

overwrite.description: 直接覆盖原文件（先自动备份）；仅在用户明确要求时使用

path.description: workbook path: an attachment's absolute path or a workspace-relative path

operations.description:
operations applied in order, one op each:
- reorder_blocks: {op, column, order:[values], within?, match?:"contains"|"exact"} put the contiguous blocks of equal values in column into this order, moving whole rows with their formats; short names match ("North" matches "North branch"); unlisted blocks stay after them in their order
- replace: {op, find, replace, columns?:[...], whole_cell?:bool} find and replace text
- set_font: {op, name?, size?, include_header?:bool} one font / size; bold and colour stay
- renumber: {op, column, start?:1, skip_if_blank?:column} number the data rows again

output.description: output name or path (a bare name goes beside the source), default <name>_修改.xlsx

overwrite.description: write over the source (backed up first); only when the user asks
